source.title: The Micro-Price: A High Frequency Estimator of Future Prices
source.version: SSRN manuscript dated 18 April 2018; pinned third-party PDF mirror

claims.locator: Manuscript PDF pages 2 and 6, equations (2)-(3) and Appendix B statement
claims.statement: The weighted mid-price equals I times the best ask plus (1-I) times the best bid, where I is best bid size divided by total best-quote size. Under the stated Brownian-imbalance toy model, the micro-price equals this weighted mid-price.

adaptations: The implementation is confined to the toy model's weighted-mid equivalence. It does not estimate the paper's full Markov-chain distant-future micro-price or reproduce the empirical price-prediction comparison.
The paper defines a fair-price estimator, not a trading rule. Mapping that estimate versus the last trade price to unit target holdings is a separate runtime demonstration.
Synthetic L1 quote/trade events exercise the contract; no source-market order-book history or original experiment is claimed.
